g.text: Interference-aware capacity and bandwidth management for DRAM/CXL memory

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #666666

g.text: Two budgets: DRAM write bandwidth (one shared budget) and DRAM capacity. CXL stays the default home of bulk writes.
